description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future

 **Job Description** **Strategic Mandate**


As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**

* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking

  

**Qualifications** **Expertise \& Technology Stack**

* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking

  

**Additional Information** **Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.**
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Overview  

Foundational Data \& Model Services sits in Data \& AI Foundations, inside Business \& Market Insights. We own the data that B\&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.  

  

About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on\-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load\-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.  

  

The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.  

  

Role  

You will own the delivery plan across the squads doing this work, and manage the dependencies between them, the platform teams we rely on, and the product teams waiting on us. Specifically, you will:  

  

Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.  

Run the migration off Hadoop and on\-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.  

Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.  

Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.  

Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.  

Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade\-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.  

Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.  

  

All about you  

We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.  

  

Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.  

Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.  

Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.  

Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.  

Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.  

A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow\-through rather than mandate.  

Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job Overview**
----------------


The Business Senior Analyst is an intermediate\-level position responsible for liaising between business users and technologists to exchange information in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning.


**Job Responsibilities:**

The candidate will execute a wide range of Enterprise Application enhancements / Implementations / upgrade and support activities within Technology Organization / Supply Chain functions, both quantitative and qualitative in nature to support program management.


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.
* Will be responsible for working with Operations/Finance and business stakeholders.
* Knowledge on AI tools, application of AI enablement for P2P processes

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

Experience


* 8\-11 years’ experience in project management
* Experienced Project manager \& business analyst in relevant field Oracle ERP Financial modules.
* PMP/SAFE certified Project managers
* Attention to detail to ensure precision of data and overall quality of outputs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.).
* Ability to embrace and master new technologies and changing processes.
* Can work independently with minimal supervision is required, as well as ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented atmosphere.
* Excellent follow\-up skills with attention to detail and ability to multi\-task, strong leadership skills, strong team\-orientation and interpersonal skills, flexibility and strong analytical skills.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills.
* Ability to establish rapport and build effective relationships across functions, across regions, and across all levels of management.
* Motivated self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and possesses the ability to successfully manage multiple requests in a deadline\-driven environment
